text.en: Shout "Fire! Fire!" to warn everyone near you.
text.yo: Pariwo "Iná! Iná!" kí gbogbo èèyàn tó wà nítòsí lè gbọ́.
text.pcm: Shout "Fire! Fire!" make everybody near you hear.

text.en: Call the OAU Fire Service: 0816 221 4241 or 0807 521 1840. Give the correct address.
text.yo: Pe Iṣẹ́ pa-iná OAU: 0816 221 4241 tàbí 0807 521 1840. Sọ àdírẹ́sì tó péye.
text.pcm: Call OAU Fire Service: 0816 221 4241 or 0807 521 1840. Talk the correct address.

text.en: If there is smoke, bend low and move out. Cover your nose with a cloth.
text.yo: Tí èéfín bá wà, tẹ̀ ara rẹ sílẹ̀ kí o sì jáde. Fi aṣọ bo imú rẹ.
text.pcm: If smoke dey, bend low comot. Use cloth cover your nose.

text.en: Leave by the nearest door or staircase. Do not stop to pack your things.
text.yo: Jáde gba ẹnu ọ̀nà tàbí àtẹ̀gùn tó súnmọ́ jù. Má dúró kó ẹrù rẹ.
text.pcm: Comot through the nearest door or staircase. No stop to pack your load.

text.en: Never go back inside for anything. Wait on open ground, away from the building.
text.yo: Má padà wọlé fún ohunkóhun. Dúró ní ibi gbangba, jìnnà sí ilé náà.
text.pcm: No go back inside for anything. Wait for open place, far from the building.

text.en: Use a fire extinguisher only on a small fire, and only if your way out is clear.
text.yo: Lo ẹ̀rọ pa-iná fún iná kékeré nìkan, tí ọ̀nà àbájáde rẹ bá ṣí sílẹ̀.
text.pcm: Use fire extinguisher only for small fire, and only if your road to comot clear.

text.en: In the hostel: never leave cooking, candles or mosquito coils burning alone.
text.yo: Ní ilé ibùgbé: má fi oúnjẹ tó ń sè, àbẹ́là tàbí oògùn ẹ̀fọn tó ń jó sílẹ̀ láìsí ẹnìkan.
text.pcm: For hostel: no leave cooking, candle or mosquito coil burn alone.

text.en: Check that the place is safe for you before you go close.
text.yo: Wò ó dájú pé ibẹ̀ kò léwu fún ọ kí o tó súnmọ́.
text.pcm: Check say the place safe for you before you go near.

text.en: Call the Health Centre: +234 810 747 5862, or 112.
text.yo: Pe Ilé ìtọ́jú ìlera: +234 810 747 5862, tàbí 112.
text.pcm: Call Health Centre: +234 810 747 5862, or 112.

text.en: Stay with the person. Talk to them and keep them calm.
text.yo: Dúró ti ẹni náà. Bá a sọ̀rọ̀ kí ọkàn rẹ̀ lè balẹ̀.
text.pcm: Stay with the person. Talk to am, make e calm down.

text.en: If there is bleeding, press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth.
text.yo: Tí ẹ̀jẹ̀ bá ń jáde, fi aṣọ mímọ́ tẹ ojú ọgbẹ́ náà mọ́lẹ̀ dáadáa.
text.pcm: If blood dey comot, use clean cloth press the wound well well.

text.en: Do not move someone who may have hurt their neck or back, unless they are in danger.
text.yo: Má gbé ẹni tí ọrùn tàbí ẹ̀yìn rẹ̀ lè ti farapa, àyàfi tí ewu bá wà níbẹ̀.
text.pcm: No move person wey fit don wound neck or back, unless danger dey there.

text.en: Tell the helpers exactly where you are. Tap "Where am I?" on the Emergency page.
text.yo: Sọ ibi tí ẹ wà ní pàtó fún àwọn olùrànlọ́wọ́. Tẹ "Níbo ni mo wà?" ní ojú-ìwé Pàjáwìrì.
text.pcm: Tell helpers exactly where una dey. Tap "Where I dey?" for Emergency page.

text.en: Move to a busy, well-lit place with other people.
text.yo: Lọ sí ibi tí èèyàn pọ̀ sí, tí ìmọ́lẹ̀ sì wà.
text.pcm: Go where plenty people dey and light dey.

text.en: Do not argue or fight. Keep your distance and walk away.
text.yo: Má jà, má sì bá wọn ṣe àríyànjiyàn. Jìnnà sí wọn kí o sì kúrò.
text.pcm: No quarrel, no fight. Stay far and waka comot.

text.en: Call campus security or 112. Tell a friend where you are.
text.yo: Pe ààbò ogba tàbí 112. Sọ ibi tí o wà fún ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ.
text.pcm: Call campus security or 112. Tell your friend where you dey.

text.en: At night, walk with friends and keep to the main roads.
text.yo: Ní alẹ́, máa rìn pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀rẹ́, kí o sì máa gba ojú ọ̀nà ńlá.
text.pcm: For night, waka with your friends and follow main road.

text.en: Your life is worth more than your phone. Do not fight for your things.
text.yo: Ẹ̀mí rẹ ṣe pàtàkì ju fóònù rẹ lọ. Má ja ìjà nítorí ẹrù rẹ.
text.pcm: Your life pass your phone. No fight for your things.

text.en: Remember how the person looked and which way they went.
text.yo: Rántí bí ẹni náà ṣe rí àti ọ̀nà tí ó gbà lọ.
text.pcm: Remember how the person be and which side e run go.

text.en: Report to campus security at once.
text.yo: Fi tó ààbò ogba létí lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
text.pcm: Report to campus security sharp sharp.

text.en: Block your bank cards and SIM with your bank and network.
text.yo: Ní kí ilé ìfowópamọ́ àti nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì rẹ dí káàdì àti SIM rẹ.
text.pcm: Make your bank and network block your card and SIM.

text.en: Stay calm. Stand where people can see you.
text.yo: Fara balẹ̀. Dúró sí ibi tí èèyàn ti lè rí ọ.
text.pcm: Calm down. Stand where people fit see you.

text.en: Open this app and tap "Use my location". It works without data.
text.yo: Ṣí ohun èlò yìí kí o tẹ "Lo ibi tí mo wà". Ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ láì lo dátà.
text.pcm: Open this app tap "Use where I dey now". E dey work without data.

text.en: Ask a porter, a security officer or a student. Show them this screen.
text.yo: Béèrè lọ́wọ́ olùṣọ́ ilé, ọlọ́pàá ààbò tàbí akẹ́kọ̀ọ́. Fi ojú-ìwé yìí hàn wọ́n.
text.pcm: Ask porter, security or student. Show dem this screen.
